title: Ocean life around Noosa

points: Dolphins, turtles and schools of colourful fish are common in the waters around Noosa Heads.
Around 18,000 humpback whales migrate past Noosa.
Loggerhead turtles nest on Noosa's beaches.
Sharks live in Noosa's coastal waters, and bull sharks are known to live in the region's rivers.

detail_blocks.text: Only two major shark attacks are known to have happened in Noosa: in the 1960s, which was fatal, and in 2013, which caused an injury.
Noosa Main Beach has standard shark nets, and there are ongoing discussions about other ways to manage sharks.
